target_description: messages from customers about charges they dispute, refund requests, or pricing concerns

messages.subject: Why am I being charged $4,200 this cycle?
messages.body: Alex — our usage shouldn't have changed but the latest invoice is more than double last month's. We need someone to walk us through where the new line items are coming from. We've been a customer for three years and this is the first time we've seen a jump like this. Can someone get back to me by end of week?

messages.subject: Disputed charge — needs resolution
messages.body: We've identified $1,800 in our last bill that doesn't match anything our team activated. Finance is holding payment until this is reconciled. I've attached our usage report. Please escalate.

messages.subject: Refund request for unused seats
messages.body: We downsized last month and notified the team on the 3rd, but we were billed for the original seat count through the end of the cycle. Can we get a prorated refund processed? Standard request, just want to make sure it doesn't fall through the cracks.

messages.subject: Confused about the new pricing tier
messages.body: Got the email about the pricing change but the per-seat number on our renewal quote doesn't match what was advertised. Either the email was wrong or the quote is wrong. Which one?

messages.subject: Considering canceling — billing issue unresolved 6 weeks
messages.body: Alex, I've been going back and forth with support since March about a duplicate charge and we still don't have a resolution. At this point I need to escalate to someone with decision-making authority or we're going to start the cancellation process. This is genuinely time-sensitive.

messages.subject: Pricing confusion on multi-year quote
messages.body: Alex — got the multi-year quote from your sales team and the per-seat number went UP versus our current annual plan. I was told multi-year would lock in better pricing. Either the quote is wrong or someone misspoke; can we get this sorted before we lose the renewal window?

messages.subject: Refund window — overpayment from migration
messages.body: When we migrated tiers in March we ended up paying for two overlapping months. I've sent the breakdown twice now and haven't heard back about the credit. Standard request, just want to keep this on someone's radar.

messages.subject: Adjusting our subscription before renewal
messages.body: We're planning to drop two seats at renewal next month. Want to make sure the prorated billing calc is straightforward and we don't get caught with another billing surprise like last cycle. Who should I talk to to confirm?

messages.subject: Q3 roadmap review — your input needed
messages.body: Hey Alex, I'm finalizing the Q3 roadmap doc by Thursday. Can you sanity-check the prioritization on the integrations track? Specifically the order between the Salesforce and HubSpot connectors. Direct report from your team.

messages.subject: All-hands deck draft v2
messages.body: Updated deck attached based on your notes from Monday. Open question on slide 14 about the Q2 retention numbers — let me know if you want me to pull those from the dashboard or if you have them handy.

messages.subject: 15-min sync this week?
messages.body: Want to grab 15 minutes to talk through the enterprise pipeline before the board meeting Friday. Anything Wed or Thu works for me.

messages.subject: Quick intro — observability platform
messages.body: Hi Alex, came across your team's job posting for an SRE and thought our observability platform might be a fit. Open to a 20-min call next week? Happy to send a deck if useful first.

messages.subject: Confidential opportunity — VP Product role
messages.body: Hi Alex, I'm working on a VP Product search for a Series C company in adjacent space. Would you be open to a confidential conversation? Happy to send the brief if there's interest.

messages.subject: New event scheduled: Roadmap review with Liu Chen
messages.body: A new event has been scheduled on your calendar. Roadmap review with Liu Chen, Thursday 2:00 PM PT, 30 minutes, video conference.

messages.subject: [ENG-4421] is now Done
messages.body: Issue ENG-4421 (Migrate webhook delivery to retry queue) was moved to Done by Maya Chen. Cycle 18 progress: 14/22 complete.

messages.subject: This week in product management
messages.body: Top reads from product leaders this week: a teardown of Notion's latest pricing change, an interview with the head of product at Linear, and three frameworks for prioritization. Read on the web.

messages.subject: [your-org/platform] PR #1284 merged
messages.body: @maya-chen merged PR #1284: Refactor connector base class. 12 commits, +843 -421 across 18 files. CI passed. Auto-deploy to staging triggered.

messages.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: New device sign-in to your work account
messages.body: A new device signed in to your work account from an unfamiliar location (Lagos, Nigeria) at 3:42 AM PT. If this wasn't you, click here to revoke access and reset your password immediately.

messages.subject: Expense report — corporate card hold
messages.body: Alex, your corporate card has been temporarily held due to an unrecognized $4,800 charge from a vendor we don't have on file. Need you to confirm or dispute before we can release the hold. Affects all team-card use including the offsite booking.

messages.subject: URGENT: Production incident — connector failures
messages.body: Hey Alex, we're seeing 60% of HubSpot connector syncs failing in the last hour. On-call has paged but we may need a comms call to enterprise customers. Can you confirm we should send the proactive notice?
